subject.title: feat(read): persist inbound media to workspace staging

question: Should unsandboxed agents receive a persistent workspace alias for inbound media beyond the already-supported canonical media reference?
rationale: Adding that alias changes workspace state and lifecycle semantics; maintainers must decide whether the extra product surface is warranted before selecting its owner and retention contract.

options.title: Keep canonical references
options.body: Do not add automatic aliases unless a concrete path-only tool workflow proves the existing managed-reference support insufficient.

options.title: Stage during inbound dispatch
options.body: Add aliases at the inbound/session lifecycle boundary with safe root writes and per-session ownership rather than mutating the read tool.

options.title: Accept read-time staging
options.body: Retain implicit read-side mutation and explicitly own the compatibility, cleanup, and security consequences.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical references
recommendation.body: Do not add automatic aliases unless a concrete path-only tool workflow proves the existing managed-reference support insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to canonical inbound references and media-tool routing.
